lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular centroids, creating a structural grid across the dorsal-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible at the transition between the patterned flank and the pale ventral region, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with shadow-defined depth along its inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four commensal fish (remoras) swimming near the pectoral fin and ventral midline.
